question: How did Jesus answer the synagogue leader about healing on the Sabbath?
options: He said the Sabbath was no longer needed
He said he would heal only on weekdays
He said they untie their animals on the Sabbath, so this daughter of Abraham should be set free
He said the woman had broken the law
explanation: Jesus said they untie an ox or donkey on the Sabbath to give it water, so this daughter of Abraham whom Satan kept bound should be set free.
